subject: Collection hold for May invoice — possible URN/staging allocation mismatch
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novumretail.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novumretail.com
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected charge and collection hold — please advise

Hi Connor,

Our finance team put a collection hold on our May invoice (INV-2025-05-31) after noticing a $3,200 line item labeled "embed backfill" we don't recognize. The charge appears under usage for 2025-05-28 and is attributed to urn:ingest-alloc:stg-9fa in the billing CSV. We believe this traffic came from a staging key that shouldn't have been billed to production.

We've attached a copy of the invoice and a small CSV with the rows flagged by our team (novum_usage_snippet_20250605.csv). Our AP team is holding payment until we have confirmation from Redwood that either: 1) the charge is valid and tied to production usage, or 2) it's misattributed and a credit is applied.

Can you confirm what that URN maps to on your side and share any request_ids or job ids so we can reconcile? We're under a hard close this week, so would appreciate a quick reply.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Finance, Novum Retail
Lena Ortiz | Novum Retail
Phone: +1 617-555-0192

Subject: Re: Unexpected charge and collection hold — please advise

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments, very helpful. I'm escalating to our billing ops team and will coordinate directly so you don't have to loop through multiple threads. Quick asks to help us triage: 

- Can you confirm the Account ID you see in the invoice header (not the company name) — sometimes staging keys are mapped to a sibling account.
- In the CSV you sent, can you point to a sample request_id (one or two) from the rows you flagged so we can pull full request traces?
- If you have any internal job IDs or the approximate timestamps in UTC for the top 3 spikes that would speed the search.

As a temporary measure, if this proves to be a misattribution we can provisionally credit the $3,200 so you can release the collection hold while we perform the audit (we typically need 48-72 hours for a full replay and traceback). Please confirm if Novum wants the provisional credit to be applied now pending final audit.

I'll follow up within the day with a case number and next steps.

Best,
Connor O'Brien

Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge and collection hold — please advise

Hi Lena — following up with results from billing ops and our usage team.

Summary of findings:
- We traced the sample request_ids you provided to a background embed backfill job that was launched by a test runner tied to a staging key (staging-9fa).
- However, the staging key had been accidentally cross-mapped to ACCT-45911 due to a previously-misapplied onboarding script. The cross-mapping caused 3,200 USD of usage to appear on your account.

Actions taken:
- We have applied a provisional credit of $3,200 to invoice INV-2025-05-31. A provisional credit confirmation PDF is attached for your records (provisional_credit_confirmation_20250609.pdf).
- We have corrected the key->account mapping to prevent recurrence and added a permanent tag to staging keys to exclude them from billing aggregations.
- Our billing team will run a final replay and provide a reconciliation report within 72 hours; if any discrepancy remains we will notify you immediately.

Next steps for Novum:
- Please release the collection hold once you receive the attached provisional credit confirmation so payment can proceed.
- If you need the provisional credit shown as a separate credit memo for AP, tell me and we'll issue one.

Apologies for the disruption; we take misattributions seriously and we'll follow up with the reconciliation report and logs (S3 traces) by Thursday. If you want me to loop legal or procurement for a formal memo, I can do that.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional_credit_confirmation_20250609.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
